leakage_signals: Unstated airline loyalty, elite-status, credits, or corporate-carrier preference
Unstated preference for lower fare versus connection buffer and exact arrival/departure times
verdict.rationale: A and D present the same two otherwise compliant PVD itineraries, merely reversing their primary/fallback order. American is $11 cheaper and arrives 10 minutes earlier Sunday; Delta has slightly longer connection buffers and arrives 10 minutes earlier Wednesday. The query gives no priority among fare, outbound arrival, return arrival, connection margin, or carrier, so neither ordering clearly dominates. B adds a BOS ground transfer, and C's United fallback is materially less convenient for only a trivial fare difference than the American fallback.
